title: A London Provisioner's Chronicle, 1550-1563, by Henry Machyn: Manuscript, Transcription, and Modernization
author: Henry Machyn
institution: University of Michigan Library / Michigan Publishing (editors Richard W. Bailey, Marilyn Miller and Colette Moore)
notes: Edition of the diary of the London merchant tailor Henry Machyn (British Library Cotton Vitellius F.v), 1550 to 1563, with manuscript images, a diplomatic transcript and a modern English rendering, browsable by year. Words are not given: the live site is behind a bot check for scripts and the Wayback copy returns the text in fragments. The edition dates from 2006 and no update is evident.
